reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Powers of authority
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates authority powers including leasing with sectarian-use restrictions, bonding, asset transfer to § 33.295 fund (repealed 2018), rate setting, inspection, and lending.

headings.title: Transfer of moneys to rebuild damaged infrastructure fund
headings.reviewNote: Mandates $4,000,000 transfer on July 1, 2013 to § 33.295 fund (repealed 2018); notes record H.B. 1035 veto override and dual 2013 effective dates.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2013/2018 notes (H.B. 1035 veto override, revisor's note on overridden emergency clause effective dates 7-05-13 and 9-11-13, and 2018 repeal of § 33.295); authority powers and 2013 $4M transfer verified.

headings.title: Designation of Missouri college savings bonds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes designating bonds, notes, or obligations as Missouri college savings bonds.

headings.title: Purposes of Missouri college savings bond terms
headings.reviewNote: Outlines purposes to encourage higher education savings and college attendance.

headings.title: Authority guidelines for terms, marketing, and sales
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes authority guidelines for structuring terms, marketing, and sales.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1988 source note; permissive Missouri college savings bond designation, purposes, and guidelines verified.

headings.title: Participation with out-of-state issuers for Missouri facilities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assistance and participation with out-of-state issuers for Missouri health and educational facilities.

headings.title: Public hearing and elected representative approval designations
headings.reviewNote: Designates authority for federal tax code public hearings and governor for elected approval.

headings.title: Determination to proceed with financing
headings.reviewNote: Requires authority determination to proceed and bars financing upon adverse determination.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1998, 1999); out-of-state issuer participation, exclusive IRC § 147(f) hearing/approval designations, and proceed determination verified.

headings.title: Acquisition of property for facilities
headings.reviewNote: Empowers authority or participating institutions to acquire real and personal property interests.

headings.title: Borrowing and security powers of participating entities
headings.reviewNote: Empowers participating educational or health partnerships, joint ventures, entities, and political subdivision institutions under § 360.015 to borrow and grant security interests.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1975, 1988); refined subsection 2 title to reflect all covered participating entities under § 360.015 rather than only public entities.

headings.title: Pledge of revenues and security indentures for bonds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes pledges, trust indentures, mortgages, remedies on default, and mandamus.

headings.title: Pooling of leases as bond security
headings.reviewNote: Permits securing bonds through pooled leases and assigned rentals across institutions.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1975 source note; bond revenue pledges, trust indentures/remedies, and lease pooling verified.

headings.title: Initial planning service fee and annual service fees
headings.reviewNote: Mandates nonrefundable initial planning service fee capped at lesser of $10,000 or 0.25% and permits annual service fee up to 0.10% of outstanding bonds.

headings.title: Proration of fees for concurrent bond issues
headings.reviewNote: Requires proration of fees among institutions in concurrent multi-institution bond issues.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1975 source note; mandatory nonrefundable initial planning fee, permissive annual service fee, and concurrent-issue proration verified.

headings.title: Financing through purchase of institution securities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bond issuance to purchase securities of participating health or educational institutions.

headings.title: Institution retention of title without lease
headings.reviewNote: Retains facility title in participating institution subject to mortgage lien without lease.

headings.title: Return of purchased securities upon bond retirement
headings.reviewNote: Directs return of purchased securities upon full retirement of authority bonds.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1975 source note; institution-securities purchase financing, title retention without lease, § 360.100 disapplication, and return of securities verified.

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines funding agreement, participating district, and school district bonds.

headings.title: Issuance of school district bonds or notes
headings.reviewNote: Empowers authority to issue bonds or notes to make loans or buy school or college obligations.

headings.title: Application of statutory authority powers
headings.reviewNote: Applies general chapter 360 powers to school district bond issuances.

headings.title: Security for school district bonds
headings.reviewNote: Permits securing bonds by district payment pledges, notes, or pooling.

headings.title: Investment of undisbursed funds and earnings credits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes investment of undisbursed funds with earnings credited to participating districts.

headings.title: Direct deposit of state aid payments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes state treasurer direct deposit from §§ 163.011–163.195 aid, § 165.011 fund withdrawals notwithstanding § 108.180, authority guidelines, and zero cost to school districts.

headings.title: Payment of issuance costs and credit enhancement
headings.reviewNote: Provides payment of issuance costs from proceeds or state distributions for voter-approved projects.

headings.title: Minimum net present value savings on refunding
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least one and one-half percent net present value savings for bond refunding.

headings.title: Commissioner of education as advisory member
headings.reviewNote: Designates commissioner of education as ex officio nonvoting advisory member.

headings.title: Preservation of local debt service levy obligations
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies districts retain legal obligations to levy required debt service and capital taxes.

headings.title: Competitive bidding for professional services
headings.reviewNote: Mandates competitive bidding for underwriters, counsel, trustees, and advisors with contract caps.

headings.title: Annual cost-effectiveness review and report
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual August 15 review and legislative report on program cost-effectiveness.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985–2005, effective 7-01-06); tightened subsection 6 title; all 12 school district/community college bond, direct-deposit, 1.5% NPV refunding, competitive bidding, and August 15 report subsections verified.

headings.title: Working capital financing and definition
headings.reviewNote: Empowers authority to issue bonds or notes to finance educational or health institution working capital and defines 'working capital'.

headings.title: Security for working capital obligations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes pledging institution payments, notes, or pooled obligations as security.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1988 source note; tightened subsection 1 title to capture both working capital financing authority and statutory definition.

headings.title: Financing self-insurance and risk management programs
headings.reviewNote: Empowers authority to finance self-insurance and risk management programs and secure obligations (source contains duplicated phrase 'for the educational institution or health institution').

headings.title: Legal effect of funded self-insurance programs
headings.reviewNote: Deems funded self-insurance equivalent to insurance purchase or political subdivision plan.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1988 source note; self-insurance/risk management financing and legal effect verified (duplicated phrase in sub 1 noted).

headings.title: Financing court-ordered school desegregation facilities and expenses
headings.reviewNote: Empowers authority to finance facilities, transportation, and salaries under court desegregation orders.

headings.title: Cooperation with state entities and statutory powers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cooperation with state entities and incorporates powers set forth in §§ 360.010 to 360.040 (verbatim statutory range; subsection 1 cites §§ 360.010 to 360.140).

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1988 source note; court-ordered school desegregation financing and state cooperation verified (verbatim §§ 360.010 to 360.040 range in sub 2 vs 360.010 to 360.140 in sub 1 noted).

headings.title: Powers cumulative and preservation of police power
headings.reviewNote: Construes powers as cumulative and preserves state and municipal police powers.

headings.title: Compliance with local zoning and building regulations
headings.reviewNote: Subjects all facilities to local planning, zoning, sanitary, and building regulations.

headings.title: Supplementary nature of statutory powers
headings.reviewNote: Provides powers are supplementary and independent of restrictions in other laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1975 source note; cumulative powers, police power preservation, local zoning/building compliance, and supplementary authority verified.

headings.title: Eligibility for construction or refinancing grant
headings.reviewNote: Makes districts with direct deposit agreements eligible for one-time bond issuance grants.

headings.title: Grant amount formula prior to July 1, 1997
headings.reviewNote: Caps pre-July 1997 grant at lesser of two percent of par value or actual issuance cost.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1995 note (effective 6-27-95); direct-deposit grant eligibility for post-1995 voter-approved projects and pre-July 1, 1997 grant cap verified.

headings.title: Biennial determination of weighted average issuance cost
headings.reviewNote: Requires authority to determine biennial weighted average cost of issuance percentage.

headings.title: Grant amount formula from July 1, 1997
headings.reviewNote: Sets post-July 1997 grant at lesser of weighted average percentage or actual costs.

headings.title: Direct deposit transfers at no cost to district
headings.reviewNote: Mandates direct deposit transfers be executed at no cost to school district.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1995 note (effective 6-27-95); tightened subsection 2 title; biennial weighted-average issuance cost determination, post-July 1, 1997 grant formula, and zero-cost transfers verified.

headings.title: Grant payment procedure and certification requirements
headings.reviewNote: Governs grant payment from state funds upon closing legal opinion and district certification.

headings.title: Minimum net present value savings on refunding
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least one and one-half percent net present value savings for bond refunding.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1995 note (effective 6-27-95); § 164.303 grant payment certification procedure and 1.5% NPV refunding savings requirement verified.

headings.title: Investment of undisbursed funds and earnings credit
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes investment of undisbursed grant funds with earnings credited to district.

headings.title: Inapplicability to new lease purchase agreements
headings.reviewNote: Excludes obligations issued to finance new lease purchase agreements.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1995 note (effective 6-27-95); undisbursed fund investment with district earnings credit and exclusion of new lease-purchase agreements verified.

headings.title: Authorized investments for authority funds
headings.reviewNote: Permits investing authority funds in listed federal, state/local, deposit, repurchase, investment-agreement, and FNMA/GNMA obligations with maturity limits (subd (3)(a) cites historical FSLIC/FSLCC wording).

headings.title: Exemption for bond proceeds held in trust
headings.reviewNote: Exempts project and reserve funds held under trust indentures or escrow agreements.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1975–1988); authorized investment categories with maturity limits (noting historical FSLCC wording in sub 1(3)(a)) and trust/escrow bond-proceeds exemption verified.
